_comment: Corpus polarity lint (change: kb-battery-honesty, audit A10). A fact unit whose text matches `subject` must not contain a clause matching `forbidden` unless a negation word precedes the match in the same clause. Correction units are exempt: they quote wrong claims on purpose. Each rule names the subtensor v486 source that settles it.
